quotes.text: Display a subscription pricing table on your website and take customers directly to Stripe Checkout.
To join the Accounts v2 preview, go to [Account previews and features](https://dashboard.stripe.com/settings/previews) in your Dashboard and enable **Reusable payment methods for Global Payouts**.
You have 30 minutes to include the client secret in the pricing table. After rendering the pricing table, you have an additional 30 minutes to complete a payment before the customer session expires.
If the customer session expires after Checkout Session creation, but before confirmation, payment confirmation fails.
Set up an [event destination](https://docs.stripe.com/events/set-up-events.md) to receive the event at your endpoint to process fulfillment and reconciliation.

answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/checkout/pricing-table, the November capture describes a Dashboard-built subscription pricing table embedded with Stripe's script and <stripe-pricing-table> element; it sends a visitor to hosted Checkout rather than implementing payment submission in the merchant page (new raw lines 5-14, 30-67). It covers flat-rate, per-seat, tiered and trial models, four products, three prices per product and three intervals, with no usage-based or Connect support (new raw lines 297-305). For an authenticated user, the server creates a Customer Session for a customer-configured Account or a Customer, with pricing_table enabled, then gives its client_secret to the element; Accounts v2 is GA for Connect and public preview for others with preview-version conditions (new raw lines 189-243). The May capture has the same core behavior and expiration outcomes (old raw lines 4-13, 210-280, 334-342). source-stripe-pricing-table.md summarizes the core but omits the November access step and provenance and compresses the two timing windows (current source lines 11-32, 59-61). An expired session can lose customer association or fail confirmation; an embed display, redirect, or Session creation is not evidence of payment completion (new raw lines 239-259).
answers.Q2: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/checkout/pricing-table, the main substantive November addition is a concrete Accounts v2 public-preview enrollment path; the older access sentence was unfinished (new raw lines 191-200; old raw lines 212-220). HTML replacing React/TypeScript examples, curl replacing Node.js calls, added image/diagram, Markdown formatting, and changed event-destination link are presentation or navigation evidence and do not prove runtime deprecation (new raw lines 15-28, 43-85, 201-237, 255-280; old raw lines 15-17, 31-106, 222-274, 292-317). source-stripe-pricing-table.md should preserve the May raw as dated history, add November provenance and correct its customer-session timing language (current source lines 1-9, 22-32, 59-61). The linked concept says the second 30-minute window follows Checkout Session creation, whereas both captures say it follows pricing-table rendering; flag that conflict reciprocally (new raw lines 239-243; old raw lines 276-280; concept lines 31-33). Keep Account versus Customer, server Customer Session versus client embed, event destination versus browser redirect, and successful Checkout versus actual payment outcome distinct (new raw lines 189-259).
